Game Overview

In Bunny Graduation Double, the core idea is straightforward: guide two charming bunnies through a pixelated forest, expertly coordinating their movements to overcome obstacles and evade traps. Master the double jump for dynamic maneuvers, timing each leap perfectly to progress. With strategic dual control, outwit level guardians and lead your furry friends to safety.
